subject: art-design
title: Mona Lisa & The Scream
welcome_lead: Two of the most recognised paintings in the world.
meta_desc: KS3 famous artworks: Mona Lisa and The Scream.
final_note: Famous artworks become symbols beyond their image.

concepts.def: Famous Paris museum holding Mona Lisa.

walkthroughs.body_html: Leonardo da Vinci's Mona Lisa (around 1503) hangs in the Louvre, Paris. Its mysterious smile uses sfumato — soft, smoky transitions with no hard lines.
Edvard Munch's The Scream (1893) shows a figure clutching their face under a blood-red sky. It is a key work of Expressionism — feeling, not realism.
Both pictures have travelled far beyond galleries — onto T-shirts, memes and emojis. A famous artwork becomes a shorthand for human feelings: mystery, dread, awe.
